subject: Next steps: compliance intake & prefill options for MedicTech
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@medictech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: compliance intake & prefill options for MedicTech

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Recap of asks from your team:
- Confirm MedicTech's SOC 2 status and expected Type II timeline.
- Whether HIPAA certification / BAA is required for the integration.
- Data residency and retention constraints for PHI.
- Preferred vendor questionnaire format (SIG/CAIQ or your custom form).

2) What Redwood can do now:
- Share a concise SOC 2 summary (scope, auditor, last test date) and a prefill template (SIG/CAIQ-style) to speed your intake.
- Map evidence we can provide (logs, configuration screenshots, architecture diagram).
- Schedule a short tech-to-tech sync with your InfoSec (suggest 30 mins).

3) Proposed timeline:
- I can send the SOC2 one-pager + prefill template by EOD today (attached).
- If you want a prefill response from Redwood, we’d aim for a 5 business day turnaround once we agree scope.

Clarifying questions for you (so we send the right prefill):
- Do you prefer SIG v3 (the consensus security questionnaire) or a CAIQ/ISV prefill? Or should we complete your custom spreadsheet?
- Any mandatory controls or evidence types (e.g., SIEM logs for 90 days, encryption key custody) we should prioritize?
- Who should we route follow-ups to on your side? (Ian? Procurement?)

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary-2026-09.pdf (one-pager), prefill-sig-template-2026-09.xlsx (blank prefill), evidence-checklist.txt (starter list).

Thanks — Rohan

--
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwoodinference.example.com
From: Jamie Li <jamie.li@medictech.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Cc: Ian Gomez <ian.gomez@medictech.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: compliance intake & prefill options for MedicTech

Thanks Rohan — great recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type I in place (last report April 2026). Type II is in progress and expected to complete end of November 2026.
- HIPAA: Yes, HIPAA applies for the pilot; we will need a BAA.
- Data residency: All PHI must remain in us-east-1. Retention: 7 years for records tied to patient care.
- Questionnaire preference: SIG v3 would be ideal (reduces back-and-forth), but our compliance team will accept a prefilled CAIQ if SIG is not available. We also have a short custom spreadsheet for procurement redlines — we can share if needed.

Priority evidence: system architecture diagram, SOC controls mapping, encryption-at-rest KMS description, and 90-day SIEM retention confirmation.

Folks: Ian (cc) will own the intake from InfoSec. Ian — can we target a tech sync the week of Sept 13?

Best,
Jamie

Subject: Re: Next steps: compliance intake & prefill options for MedicTech

Jamie — appreciated. IAN copied and noted. Next actions from Redwood: 

- We will return a prefilled SIG v3 spreadsheet and a short SOC2 mapping doc. If you prefer CAIQ instead, say the word and we’ll pivot.
- I’ll include a BAA template and call out timeline constraints for SOC2 Type II in our notes.
- Proposed target for Redwood prefill: Sept 14 (one-week turnaround). If that works for Ian’s intake, we can lock it in.

Ian — are there any controls you want us to skip replying to in the prefill (e.g., vendor-specific encrypted key custody questions) or any evidence we should avoid sending to the inbox and instead push to an SFTP/KMS-backed share? We can redact PII in screenshots; we just want to surface the right artifacts.

Attaching the prefill we sent you earlier for reference and a SOC2 executive summary.

Thanks — Rohan

Attachments: prefill-sig-template-2026-09.xlsx; redwood-soc2-summary-2026-09.pdf
